scope_of_work.work_description: Complete tear-off and replacement of existing built-up gravel roof (with modified bitumen patches) on a 1998 industrial warehouse (85,000 sq ft / 7,900 m2) with attached 2006 office wing. New 60-mil TPO single-ply system with minimum R-30 polyiso insulation (two-layer, staggered joints), gypsum/HD polyiso cover board, new flashings at 47 penetrations, resolution of existing ponding, and phased installation (max 15,000 sq ft exposed, daily watertight) to maintain occupied pharmaceutical cold-storage warehouse and office operations.

membrane_system_specified.thickness_spec: Minimum 60 mil; white, minimum 80% solar reflectance; heat-welded seams required

included_items: Complete tear-off of existing BUR/modified bitumen membrane, flashings, gravel, insulation, adhesives down to deck
Deck inspection and repair (steel deck; isolated corrosion near drains expected; wood deck sections in office wing may require replacement per unit price)
New 60-mil TPO single-ply membrane, white (>=80% reflectance), heat-welded seams
New polyiso insulation, minimum R-30, two layers with staggered joints
Cover board: minimum 1/4 inch gypsum or HD polyiso over all insulation
Tapered insulation or additional drainage to resolve existing ponding (SW quadrant ~1,200 sq ft)
New flashings at all 47 penetrations, parapets, roof edges, HVAC curbs, skylights, wall interfaces
Base flashing minimum 8 inches above finished roof surface
Drain bowl replacement where seals are compromised; new clamping collars as required
HVAC protection and coordination (12 units remain operational; 72-hour notice for any shutdown)
Phased installation: no more than 15,000 sq ft exposed at any time; each phase watertight at end of day; weekend weather protection
Daily cleanup and final site cleanup; debris removed daily
Professional conduct for occupied building with temperature-sensitive pharmaceutical tenants
Fastener pattern meeting wind uplift calculations for the geographic zone
excluded_items: Actual asbestos or lead abatement costs (owner's responsibility if ACM/lead discovered during tear-off; bidder to include contingency planning in schedule per RFP §2.3)
alternates_requested: Additional insulation above R-30 code minimum (pricing per R-value increment)
Infrared moisture survey of existing roof prior to removal
Post-installation thermal imaging scan to verify installation quality
Tapered insulation system (if not included in base bid)
Wood deck replacement unit pricing (office wing sections)

submission_requirements: Total bid price (lump sum) with HST indicated separately
Detailed breakdown of costs (materials, labour, disposal, etc.)
Product data sheets for all proposed materials
Project schedule with key milestones and phasing plan
Phasing plan describing approach to working in occupied building
Allowances (clearly identified with basis of estimate)

extraction_notes: Classified as obc_part_3: building area ~7,900 m2 >> 600 m2 threshold (OBC 1.1.2.2), industrial/business occupancy. Part 3 + Part 5 (Environmental Separation) apply.
Roof type: low_slope_commercial — existing BUR replaced with fully-adhered/mechanically-attached TPO on steel deck; standard low-slope commercial industrial warehouse.

owner_type inferred as private_commercial (Tenebrus Capital appears to be a private capital/real-estate owner; not BPS, condo, school board, hospital, or municipal). BPS Procurement Directive not applicable.

Evaluation weighting taken from RFP §7 (not defaults). Raw RFP weights: Total Price 35%, Proposed Materials/Systems 20%, Warranty Terms 15%, Schedule & Phasing 12%, Qualifications/References 10%, Safety 5%, Value Engineering 3% = 100%. Mapped to schema categories: price=35, technical_approach=23 (Materials/Systems 20 + Value Engineering 3, because schema has no distinct materials/VE buckets), warranty_materials=15, schedule=12, experience_references=10 (RFP Qualifications/References), qualifications_certifications=5 (RFP Safety Record/Program). Sums to 100.

RFP DEFICIENCY — Warranty type NOT specified in §9.6 (only 20-year manufacturer + 2-year workmanship minimums given). Default total_system_ndl applied per skill rule for Part 3 commercial. Owner should explicitly require NDL (No Dollar Limit) Total System warranty — without this, bidders will offer cheapest interpretation (material-only prorated), yielding non-comparable bids.

Bid bond NOT required by RFP. §9.2 lists only post-award Performance (50%) and L&M (50%) bonds; §6.2 Required Content does not list a bid bond; §5.1 Mandatory Requirements does not list a bid bond. bid_bond_percent deliberately OMITTED from mandatory_requirements to avoid the Exercise 6 regression where bidders were failed for missing bonds the RFP never requested.

addenda_acknowledgment_required, non_collusion_declaration_required, and completed_operations_years deliberately OMITTED from mandatory_requirements because the RFP does not invoke them. Setting them would disqualify bidders for requirements the RFP never stated.

RFP DEFICIENCY — No wood-deck replacement unit-price allowance (board-foot allowance) specified. §2.1(2) says 'provide unit pricing' without an included quantity, guaranteeing change orders on office-wing wood deck sections.

RFP DEFICIENCY — §3.2 cover board spec ('minimum 1/4 inch gypsum or HD polyiso') is below industry-standard 1/2 inch DensDeck Prime / HD polyiso. 1/4 inch gypsum may not meet manufacturer prerequisites for 25-30 year TPO NDL warranties (see fixture 02 §1.3).

RFP DEFICIENCY — §3.4 requires fastener pattern to meet wind uplift but does not mandate submittal of a CSA A123.21 calculation or named listed assembly. Bids will be non-comparable on wind uplift design basis.

RFP DEFICIENCY — 1998 building: Designated Substance Report (OHSA §30) is owner's obligation per O. Reg. 278/05. §2.3 pushes ACM discovery risk to bidders rather than providing a DSR with the tender package. All bids will carry abatement uncertainty.

RFP DEFICIENCY — §3.1 'fully adhered preferred; mechanically attached acceptable' creates unequal bid comparison. Adhered is materially more expensive; without a mandated method, price comparisons are apples-to-oranges.

RFP DEFICIENCY — 90-day schedule with $500/day liquidated damages (§9.5), phasing constraint of 15,000 sq ft max exposed (§4.3), tapered-insulation ponding remediation, and potential ACM discovery is aggressive. Schedule risk is high; owner should reconsider LD rate or extend window.

RFP DEFICIENCY — No explicit CRCA membership, Skilled Trades Ontario Certificate of Qualification requirement, or WSIB NEER/CAD-7/MAP threshold stated despite §5.1(5) requiring experience rating letter.
